items.title: 3M (MMM) Taps Jennifer Cunningham For Chief Human Resources Officer
items.summary: 3M (NYSE: MMM) appointed Jennifer Cunningham as Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer. Cunningham will lead 3M's global human resources organization, including talent, culture and leadership development. The leadership change is aimed at shaping 3M's approach to workforce strategy and internal transformation.
